description: A PHP class for parsing PROPFIND request bodies in WebDAV, handling XML input streams and extracting property information.

classes.name: _parse_propfind
classes.description: Helper class for parsing PROPFIND request bodies in WebDAV, managing XML parsing and property extraction.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the parser, opens input stream, sets up XML parser, and processes input to extract properties.

methods.name: _startElement
methods.description: Handles the start of an XML element, managing namespace and property collection based on element depth.

methods.name: _endElement
methods.description: Handles the end of an XML element, primarily decrementing the depth counter.
